title: Delay Tool Usage
description: Delay right-clicking with tools to prevent accidental block changes
body:
> **NOTE:** _This mod is packaged as part of [Great Big World](https://modrinth.com/mod/great-big-world) and was made a standalone mod so that players can enjoy it separately. Do not download both with the intent of using them together._
> 
# Delay Tool Usage
A simple mod that adds a 4-tick delay when right-clicking with Axes or Shovels before interacting with a block. Once the delay is up, right-click functionality works at normal speed. This prevents accidental log stripping or shovel pathing.

> _This mod is free to use in modpacks with credit._
